meta.notes: get('nse_momentum_score'). Inputs are JSON and each case is recomputed from them; a raise is stored as {"raises": {"type", "message"}} (pydantic: "errors" instead of "message"). Polars frames are {columns, dtypes, rows}; pandas frames add index and write NA/NaN/NaT as null. Prices: close is adjusted, close_raw is the exchange print (house rule 6). Regenerate with `.venv/bin/python ../tools/parity/golden_ranking.py` from decile-blueprint.

output.definition: NSE's normalised momentum score: 1 + Z (or 1/(1 - Z)) of 0.5 Z12 + 0.5 Z6 over the Nifty 200 F&O-eligible set.
output.label: NIFTY200 MOMENTUM 30 SCORE (NSE METHODOLOGY)
